learning_outcomes.text: Knows the basic principles of fluid mechanics and its application to solving problems in the field of engineering. Calculation of pipes, channels and fluid systems.
Knows the fundamentals of tribology and its fields of application.

teaching_methods: Introductory activities: Concept and methods of the subject
assessment_rules: The second call (resit) consists of an exam with 100% of the grade.
